title: Observability: Request Tracing Drilldown & Span Timeline prototype and UX review
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Design a Request Tracing Explorer in Redwood Console that lets engineers open a single request, inspect spans, view a timeline, follow correlation IDs, and filter across traces. Deliver a high-fidelity Figma prototype, interaction spec, and usability notes for handoff to Eng.

Scope:
- Single-request drilldown view with span list and waterfall timeline
- Highlight correlation IDs and related request links
- Timeline zoom and hover-to-inspect span details
- Filters for service, model, region, latency buckets, and error tags
- Linkage to rollouts and cost breakdown (context panel)
- Mobile/responsive considerations for on-call quick look

Acceptance criteria:
- Figma prototype with interactive timeline and span popover
- Annotated interaction spec (keyboard shortcuts, focus order, ARIA notes)
- Usability test notes from 3 engineering reviewers and 2 SREs
- Engineering handoff doc with API contract suggestions and edge-cases

Constraints and requirements:
- Must work with existing trace payload (span start/end epoch, operation, tags, correlation_id)
- Prefer incremental implementation to avoid perf impact: start with client-side render of pre-aggregated spans
- Support for long-trace streaming (pagination or progressive load)
